finding.message: The quantifier ' *' can exchange characters with ' *'. Using any string accepted by / +/, this can be exploited to cause at least polynomial backtracking. This is going to cause exponential backtracking resulting in exponential worst-case runtime behavior.

reason: This exact constructed dependency regex retains sticky uy flags and is entered at an explicitly discovered carrier marker with lastIndex set by the source-model caller. Task IDs exclude whitespace and commas. The reported exchangeable ASCII spaces themselves satisfy the final (?=$|\s) assertion: when a downstream clause rejects, backing off at the first exchanged whitespace allows the outer repetition to stop and accept that boundary, instead of enumerating every partition against a mandatory rejecting suffix. Seven actual-public-parser families (4000/16000, killable four-second children) completed, including bare/spaced invalid suffixes, malformed comma chains and valid clauses; direct tests bind dependsOn, exact carrier end and unchanged authored spans. This caller-specific analysis is distinct from an unsupported/timeout result; finite CPU probes do not establish a universal whole-parser complexity bound. The killable public probe independently fingerprints its actual bounded process owner.
